title: Qualification receipt
description: Evidence that a profile met a role's bar on a suite. Valid only while role version, profile hash, suite hash, CLI version, model and config fingerprint all still match, and before expires_at. Otherwise the router treats the status as UNKNOWN. Receipts issued before M3.1 are kept as written, do not validate against this schema, and are read only through effective_status, which reports them UNKNOWN.

kind.description: single qualifies one profile; team_gate records a gate result for loop mode.

sha256.description: Canonical hash of the role file, so an edit without a version bump still voids the receipt.

ids.description: One id for single; all participating ids for team_gate.

sha256.description: Hash of the canonicalized profile file(s).

runner_config_sha256.description: Hash of the Phase 2 isolation flags. Superseded by config_fingerprint. Receipts issued before M3.1 carry it, are kept as written, do not validate against this schema, and are read only through effective_status, which reports them UNKNOWN.

config_fingerprint.description: Required. The model client's config_fingerprint(): isolation and permission settings in force for the seat.

model.description: Model actually reported by the model client, not the requested one.

workdir_context_sha256.description: Hash of AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md in the suite working directory.

n_measured.description: Cases with a measured answer (final outcome ok or invalid). Scores are computed over these only. Absent on receipts issued before stall handling.

unmeasured.description: Cases without a measured answer, with their final outcome. Never scored as a miss or as clean; any entry keeps the status UNKNOWN.

basis.description: Required. How the metric was judged: against the interval (conservative end) or as a point value. Receipts issued before M3.1 lack it, do not validate against this schema, and are read only through effective_status, which reports them UNKNOWN.

arm.description: team_gate only: cross_model_loop, same_model_loop, single_pass, n_sample_vote.

list_usd.description: Notional list price where the model client reports it. Not a charge on flat-rate plans.
